The current hours and weekly firing rates imply the following times until each kiln hits the 10 000-hour relining threshold:

- Vaga: 600 h remaining ÷ 60 h/week = 10 weeks
- Pinega: 1 100 h remaining ÷ 90 h/week ≈ 12.2 weeks
- Sura: 1 800 h remaining ÷ 120 h/week = 15 weeks

Vaga, however, is withdrawn at the end of the season and will never be relined. Of the two kilns that will actually be relined, Pinega therefore reaches the threshold first.

ANSWER: pinega
